invariants.rule: No direct player worker or army commands
invariants.proof: role-restricted command tests and G04/G10 player verbs

invariants.rule: Only Travel and Wait advance World Turns
Travel/Wait increments one active faction seat
Round completes from captured active roster
Technology draft occurs once per completed round
Ten VP interrupts immediately in event order
Era collapse follows theoretical-capacity ranking
Only remaining winner is preserved
Core selection and fission are deterministic
Collapsed assets become inert ruins with typed disposition
Legacy sites remain operational under explicit rules
Living people and active quests survive era changes
Immutable geography survives transitions and cycles
Catan goods and industrial resources use separate namespaces
Catan dice grants never create industrial raw resources
Industrial deposits are shared finite layers
Node processor slots obey the configured cap
All 60 recipes per era remain available in full catalogue
Industry advances globally in Game Time
Worker animation cannot block or drive production
Workers and carts retain persistent identity
Every military unit retains persistent identity
Strategic formation movement uses World Turns
Local tactical battles use exclusive Godot leases
Wizard can destroy any local ordinary unit or building
Wizard is immune to ordinary faction military and buffs stack safely
Wizard/hazard duels freeze world clocks
Catastrophe treatment respects visit allowance
Only ordinary terminal catastrophe ends the run
Runtime narrative has no LLM or internet dependency
Prose and content cannot directly write world truth
Persistent and leased state have exclusive truth owners
invariants.proof: duplicate/crash/stale lease tests and G01 writer instrumentation

invariants.rule: Quest rewards for colours, slots and Aspects are bounded and once-only
Replay records deterministic inputs, time, manifests and policy choices
